title: Jonah Flees from God
description: Jonah tries to flee from God's call to go to Nineveh by taking a ship to Tarshish, but the Lord sends a violent storm over the sea. The sailors cast lots and discover that Jonah is the cause, and at his own suggestion they throw him into the sea, which immediately becomes calm.

versions.title: Jonah Flees from God
versions.description: Jonah tries to flee from God's call by taking a ship to Tarshish, but a violent storm strikes the ship. The sailors cast lots and find out that Jonah is responsible for the storm, and he is thrown into the sea.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Jonah 1 has only 16 verses in the Norwegian division (verse 17 does not exist - it corresponds to Jonah 2:1 in the Norwegian Bible). Should be adjusted to 1:1-16.
